French version / Version française: Indices du risqué de feu de forêt | CarrefourGéo Ontario

This Forest Fire Danger Rating is a general depiction of the forest fire danger ratings for various regions of Ontario. It is designed only to show the overall danger in large areas as: 

  • Low
  • Medium
  • High
  • Extreme
  • No Data (when applicable)


There may be more specific reports of conditions from municipalities or townships. Check specific danger conditions and possible fire restrictions with local authorities. The Forest Fire Info Map shows active fires, current fire danger and restricted fire zones in place due to high fire danger.
